title: 2026-10-21 英文軌：詞塊與跟讀（自然男聲樣品）
description: 昨日回顧、短文、5 個詞塊（例句附中文意思並停頓跟讀）、1 個句型與一句輸出練習。英文為美式發音。
queue: 這裡是今天的英文練習。開車請專心，你只需要用耳朵聽，再開口跟著念。
第一段，昨天的回顧。我先說中文，停四秒，請你說出英文，然後我再念答案。
第二段，今天的短文。先聽一次，再聽中文意思，最後慢速再聽一次。

This week, the IMF raised its forecast for global growth to three point one percent. The boom in AI investment helped offset the energy shock caused by conflict in the Middle East. In marketing, a survey found that most teams are only scratching the surface of AI search. And in brain science, researchers showed that stimulating about twenty neurons can often trigger a learned movement in mice. Small things can have big effects.
中文意思。這個星期，IMF 把全球成長預測上調到百分之三點一。AI 投資的熱潮，幫忙抵銷了中東衝突造成的能源衝擊。在行銷領域，一項調查發現，多數團隊對 AI 搜尋只做到皮毛。在腦科學領域，研究者顯示，刺激大約二十個神經元，往往就能在小鼠身上觸發一個學過的動作。小事情，可以帶來大影響。

In marketing, a survey found that most teams are only scratching the surface of AI search. And in brain science, researchers showed that stimulating about twenty neurons can often trigger a learned movement in mice. Small things can have big effects.
第三段，今天的五個詞塊。每一個，我會念詞塊，說中文，念例句，說例句的意思，再慢速念一次，然後停三秒，請你跟著念。
The IMF raised its forecast for global growth to three point one percent.
意思是，IMF 把全球成長預測上調到百分之三點一。
The IMF raised its forecast for global growth to three point one percent.
Strong AI investment helped offset the energy shock.
意思是，強勁的 AI 投資，幫忙抵銷了能源衝擊。
Strong AI investment helped offset the energy shock.
Most teams are only scratching the surface of AI search.
意思是，多數團隊對 AI 搜尋只做到皮毛。
Most teams are only scratching the surface of AI search.
Early adopters may gain a long-term advantage.
意思是，早期採用者可能取得長期優勢。
Early adopters may gain a long-term advantage.
意思是，觸發學會的動作。
A small signal can trigger a learned movement.
意思是，一個小小的訊號，就能觸發一個學會的動作。
A small signal can trigger a learned movement.
Whether A works depends on B
意思是，A 行不行得通，取決於 B。
Whether the lesson succeeds depends on how ready the students are.
意思是，課程是否成功，取決於學生準備得如何。
Whether the lesson succeeds depends on how ready the students are.
第五段，輪到你。請用這個句型，在心裡說一句關於你上一堂課的英文。停八秒。
Whether the game works depends on how clear the rules are.
意思是，這個遊戲行不行得通，取決於規則有多清楚。
今天的五個詞塊，會在明天、三天後、七天後，再出現一次。
